info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Bsd Documents API

params.name: accountingSystemId
params.description: Identifier of the supplier, which this document relates to, as it was used in the SMD.

params.name: branchId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the buyer branch, which this document relates to,
as it has been configured on the platform.

params.name: state
params.description: The state of the document in Buyer Sourced Documents

params.name: documentType
params.description: The type of the document

params.name: externalDocumentId
params.description:
Unique identifier to the customer. It can be a customer-generated UUID, an ERP document ID,
or an ID from a scanning solution. The external ID must also be present in the actual UBL
of invoices and credit notes in the file ID reference.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of responses to get

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
We currently only support ordering the documents by `created`, but that might change in the future.
The ordering is specified after a colon `:`. By default, we order ascending (`asc`).

items.docs:
Get an overview of all the documents the buyer has staged for its suppliers -
optionally filtered to match the chosen parameters.
Since there can be millions of documents, the results can be paginated. If the
total number of rows matching the filter parameters is large, the total count
in the result is an estimate and may deviate significantly from the actual value.

params.name: branchId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the buyer branch, which this document relates to, as it has been configured on the

params.name: documentProfileId
params.description: The UBL document profile of the posted document.

params.name: externalDocumentId
params.description:
Identifier of the invoice the document relates to. I.e. if the document is an invoice, then it can be
its own invoice number.

params.name: documentReferenceId
params.description:
Identifier (externalDocumentId) of a document that current document refers to. I.e. if the document is
an application response, then it can have a documentReferenceId that points to an invoice.
Staging an application response without supplying a documentReferenceId is considered an error.

params.name: sourceRef
params.description: Customer reference to where the documents were sourced from.
